subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths in the host TUI process, or should it render only trusted structured image/media-store references?
rationale: The feature crosses from model/tool output into host-local file reads and terminal graphics output, which is a security and product boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Keep absolute MEDIA reads only with an explicit trusted-root policy, tests, and live proof across local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the feature tracked in the canonical issue while this stale draft waits for a sponsored boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the TUI component surface and the image_generate tool path that this feature connects.
